result.instructions: Tools for Bridgit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is available to staff a new project next month?"; "Which roles on our active projects are still unfilled?"; "Who has time off or an unavailability period this quarter?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bridgit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bridgit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bridgit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bridgit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bridgit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bridgit_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the Bridgit accounts the signed-in service account can access, with name, status and person/project counts. Use it to check the account id. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/Accounts.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item (default 0).

tools.name: bridgit_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people (workforce members) in the account, with name, title, email, state, employment dates and manager. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Persons.

uniqueId.description: Filter by the person's unique id (employee number).

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item (default 0).

tools.name: bridgit_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Get one person by id: title, state, employment dates, manager, groupings and conflict flags. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Persons/{id}.

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

tools.name: bridgit_get_person_allocations
tools.title: Get a person's allocations
tools.description: List one person's allocations (role assignments on projects) within an optional date range. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Persons/{id}/allocations.

roleId.description: Only allocations on this role id.

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

tools.name: bridgit_get_person_availability
tools.title: Get person availability
tools.description: Get how many days until each person is next available (with the availability windows). Use it to find who can staff new work. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Persons/availabilities.

boundRange.description: Limit results to the start-end window.

includeUnavailable.description: Include people who are unavailable in the window.

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

tools.name: bridgit_list_unavailabilities
tools.title: List unavailabilities
tools.description: List periods when people are unavailable (time off, pre-employment, post-employment, unavailability) in the account. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/persons/unavailabilities.

boundRange.description: Limit results to the start-end window.

tools.name: bridgit_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects in the account with state, dates, hours per week, unfilled role counts and current phases. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Projects.

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item (default 0).

tools.name: bridgit_list_person_projects
tools.title: List projects per person
tools.description: List the current projects each person is allocated to, optionally for chosen project states and types. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Persons/current-projects.

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

tools.name: bridgit_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List salaried roles across projects: role name, project, dates, and whether each role is filled. Set unfilled to true to find open roles. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/Accounts/{id}/roles.

projectId.description: Only roles on this project id.

relativeDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time the results are relative to (default: now).

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item (default 0).

tools.name: bridgit_list_person_certifications
tools.title: List person certifications
tools.description: List certifications held by people in the account (name, issue and expiry details). Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/Accounts/{id}/person-certifications.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item (default 0).

tools.name: bridgit_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the Bridgit user accounts (admins and staff who sign in) with their state. Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/users.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item (default 0).

tools.name: bridgit_list_phases
tools.title: List phases
tools.description: List the account's project phases (the ordered stages a project moves through). Bridgit API: GET /rp/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/Phases.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Bridgit
prompts.description: What you can do with Bridgit here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_who_can_staff_new_work
prompts.title: Find who can staff new work
prompts.description: Check how many days until each person is next available, with the availability windows. List the people in the account to see who can take on a new project.

prompts.name: find_unfilled_roles_on_projects
prompts.title: Find unfilled roles on projects
prompts.description: List the salaried roles across projects and filter them to the unfilled ones. Read the projects with their state, dates and unfilled role counts.

prompts.name: see_who_is_allocated_to_a_project_now
prompts.title: See who is allocated to a project now
prompts.description: List the current projects of each person, filtered by project state or type. Open one person's allocations to see the roles they hold.

prompts.name: check_time_off_and_unavailability
prompts.title: Check time off and unavailability
prompts.description: List the unavailability periods in the account, such as time off or pre-employment. Read one person's profile for the employment dates and the manager.

prompts.name: review_certifications_and_project_phases
prompts.title: Review certifications and project phases
prompts.description: List the certifications held by people, with their issue and expiry details. List the ordered phases that a project moves through.
